what: Coca-Cola owns the Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta, Minute Maid, Powerade, smartwater and Costa brands. It mostly sells concentrate to independent bottlers, which make and distribute the drinks.
customers: Bottling partners worldwide, retailers and restaurants, and billions of consumers.
money: syrups and concentrates sold to bottlers at high margins
bottling operations the company still owns and juices and dairy
moat: One of the world's most valuable brands and a distribution system that reaches almost every store on the planet.
risks: Health trends away from sugary drinks
